about: NAME-ONLY mirror of the terms the other HQ owns. Definitions are deliberately absent and must never be added here: one term, one owner, one definition, one file. This file exists so the gate can reject a redefinition of a foreign term without importing another repo's source (Federation Invariant 1 — vendor small pure pieces, never import). To extend one of these terms, edit it in gaia-skill-tree's scripts/lexicon/lexicon.<namespace>.json and update this mirror in the same PR cycle.
